capabilities.feature: PDF file structures and reported recovery
capabilities.implemented: Classic/xref streams, object streams, hybrid revisions, page trees and reported reconstruction. Reported unsigned integer/endobj separation requires its exact effective xref generation/offset and complete physical span; original bytes, ordinary stream validation and strict historical snapshots remain unchanged. Nonnegative declared stream lengths are checked against the unchanged caller cap before usize conversion; negative/malformed, in-cap and cyclic rules remain unchanged.
capabilities.remaining: Current-corpus recovery classification; external resources require a host contract.

capabilities.implemented: Complete-buffer opening, lazy object caches and immutable source bytes are available.
capabilities.remaining: Immutable range sources, missing-data state, scoped loading, linearization and resumable host jobs (ADR 0035 proposed).

capabilities.implemented: Standard security R2-R6, RC4/AES and R6 SASLprep; CLI supports legacy text conversion.
capabilities.remaining: Public-key handlers, encrypted history and browser legacy text conversion; writing encryption is E01.

capabilities.implemented: TrueType/OpenType glyf, Type 1, CFF Expert/ExpertSubset and FDSelect 4; default CFF2 blends.
capabilities.remaining: Remaining formats, variations, executable programs and policy-controlled hinting; see the font inventory.

capabilities.implemented: Provider-backed horizontal substitution for the supported Adobe collections; embedded vertical text works.
capabilities.remaining: Vertical substituted glyph forms/metrics and unavailable provider/collection coverage.

capabilities.implemented: JPEG sequential/progressive with Huffman/arithmetic, CCITT G3/G4, JBIG2 regions and JPEG 2000 Part 1.
capabilities.remaining: Residual JPEG, CCITT, JBIG2 and JPX subvariants are enumerated in the tag dispositions; baseline-supported valid cases still need G01 fixtures.

capabilities.implemented: SMaskInData 1/2 decode and compositing, including alpha normalization/unpremultiplication; explicit PDF Indexed spaces retain direct index/opacity channels without a container palette, including first/last opacity order.
capabilities.remaining: Opacity combined with an explicit PDF Indexed space and a JPX container palette still requires channel mapping; broader colour/layout interactions remain R02 work.

capabilities.implemented: Explicit PDF colour spaces and embedded Gray/RGB/CMYK mapping; embedded ICC forward profiles use the bounded cache and existing transforms (Gray/RGB pixel fixtures); eight-bit unsigned sYCC converts through the IEC Annex F matrix with explicit PDF override and alpha fixtures.
capabilities.remaining: Other/mixed sYCC precisions, Lab-input profiles, multiple-colour precedence and unsupported selected-transform fallback; remaining channel/layout and interaction coverage.

capabilities.implemented: Gray/RGB/CMYK groups, knockout, blend modes, masks, forward ICC and process/spot overprint display.
capabilities.remaining: Destination/inverse ICC, calibrated group destinations, black-point compensation and transfer-region combinations.

capabilities.implemented: One interpreter, prepared scenes, per-buffer formats and one exact band executor; paths, clips, shadings and patterns.
capabilities.remaining: Singular-transform/pattern compatibility cases and independent accuracy evidence for difficult geometry.

capabilities.implemented: Stored appearances, Link/Square borders, Text icons and supported empty widgets.
capabilities.remaining: Other subtype appearances, richer borders, nonempty/rotated widgets and interaction states.

capabilities.implemented: Text/choice/button filling, appearance generation, saved values and appearances, browser preview/discard/download.
capabilities.remaining: Rich text, broader encodings/transforms, generated button states and nested direct fields; XFA belongs to V03.

capabilities.implemented: Actions are inert views; XFA is detected; ordinary AcroForms have separate support.
capabilities.remaining: Explicit host capability/ADR decisions, XFA layout/data/events and baseline-supported script/action subsets.

capabilities.implemented: Geometric text/search, replacement text, a separate tagged logical view and a screen-reader-readable DOM layer.
capabilities.remaining: Logical-view integration into viewer accessibility, namespaces, remaining replacements and bidi/script reconstruction.

capabilities.implemented: Optional-content evaluation with View usage; library/CLI overprint choices.
capabilities.remaining: Layer UI/configuration and Print/Export usage, print preferences and host/viewer overprint control.

capabilities.implemented: RenderContext lends final RGBA bands after preflight; fallible consumers and stops between bands; CLI streams PPM.
capabilities.remaining: Persistent pause/resume, host active-request cancellation and async backpressure; calls currently restart.

capabilities.implemented: Whole-buffer PNG and DEFLATE encoders in the codec crate.
capabilities.remaining: Facade/CLI PNG output and incremental PNG/DEFLATE; extend existing algorithms and band output.

capabilities.implemented: ImageSource describes encoded images and defers sample decoding for rendering.
capabilities.remaining: Asset/resource/occurrence inventory, exact-stream eligibility and normalized isolated-image export APIs.

capabilities.feature: Writing, full rewrite and encryption output
capabilities.implemented: Deterministic new PDF 1.7 output and classic/xref-stream incremental revisions. CLI roundtrip preserves original bytes only; host/viewer writing is limited to filled-form saves.
capabilities.remaining: Full rewrite, object deletion/streams, PDF 2.0 output and encryption-on-write; modified saves currently require strict unencrypted input.

capabilities.implemented: Immutable transactions, rollback, no-op byte preservation and form editing.
capabilities.remaining: Typed page/content/annotation authoring, merge/split, resource remapping, undo/redo and associated service edits.

capabilities.implemented: Incremental edits preserve prior revisions; they provide no sanitization guarantee.
capabilities.remaining: Content-aware removal plus full rewrite and independent hidden-content/canary scans.

capabilities.feature: Historical signatures and structural change analysis
capabilities.implemented: Historical discovery, ByteRange/revision coverage and structural DocMDP/FieldMDP classification.
capabilities.remaining: Encrypted/repaired history and remaining transforms/exceptions; integrate results with save permission enforcement. No signature inspection command or host request is exposed.

capabilities.feature: CMS integrity and PDF trust integration
capabilities.implemented: CMS/CAdES/RFC3161 integrity; separate host-anchored PKI path and offline complete/indirect/delta CRL APIs.
capabilities.remaining: PDF results still leave trust/time/revocation unchecked; connect real crypto and add OCSP, TSA and PAdES/LTV policy. No signature inspection command or host request is exposed.

capabilities.implemented: Verification-only primitives and original-byte-preserving incremental infrastructure.
capabilities.remaining: ADR for host signing provider, reservations, CMS/CAdES creation, timestamps and independent validation.

capabilities.implemented: Version headers and PDF/X print-intent declarations are recognized; this is not profile validation.
capabilities.remaining: Explicit PDF/A, PDF/UA, PDF/X and baseline-supported extension validators and conforming creation gates.

capabilities.feature: Destinations, links, outlines, labels and inert actions
capabilities.implemented: Typed trees, destinations, outlines, links and labels; host reading requests and browser navigation.
capabilities.remaining: CLI export, navigation mutation and additional host-approved action types.

capabilities.feature: Info dictionary, XMP and document language
capabilities.implemented: Low-level trailer/catalog/object/stream access can reach metadata.
capabilities.remaining: Typed metadata/XMP retrieval, validation, editing and facade/CLI/host/viewer integration.

capabilities.implemented: Low-level objects/streams and generic name-tree traversal exist.
capabilities.remaining: Typed EmbeddedFiles/AF APIs, safe extraction naming, payload streaming and editing.

capabilities.implemented: Collection dictionaries remain accessible through generic object APIs.
capabilities.remaining: Typed collection schema, file relationships, ordering, presentation and authoring.

capabilities.implemented: Page rendering supports caller-generated previews; the browser maintains rendered thumbnails.
capabilities.remaining: Typed embedded Thumb extraction and dedicated thumbnail export API; generated previews are not embedded asset extraction.

capabilities.implemented: Bounded snapshots for unrepaired unencrypted revisions and signature discovery.
capabilities.remaining: Encrypted/repaired history and explicit public history browsing/export.

capabilities.implemented: Handler identity is recognized and refused explicitly.
capabilities.remaining: Adobe.PubSec and any baseline-supported extension handler; host key-provider policy.

capabilities.implemented: Typed form fields/filling and inert action descriptions exist.
capabilities.remaining: Data import/export, reset/submit workflows and host-approved event/calculation execution.

capabilities.implemented: Generic object transactions can express low-level updates; saved appearance rendering exists.
capabilities.remaining: Typed annotation authorship, replies, geometry, flattening and host/viewer editing.

capabilities.feature: Insert, remove, reorder, merge and split pages
capabilities.implemented: Generic transactions and deterministic new-document writing exist.
capabilities.remaining: Typed page-tree mutation, resource grafting and merge/split APIs with save/reopen checks.

capabilities.feature: Optional OCR and searchable text insertion
capabilities.implemented: Text extraction works on encoded PDF text; there is no OCR engine/provider contract.
capabilities.remaining: Baseline optional OCR API probes, host provider ADR, language assets and accessible result insertion.

capabilities.implemented: Positioned text, layout/search and tagged logical text exist.
capabilities.remaining: Typed table detection/extraction, cell structure and independent table fixtures.

capabilities.feature: SVG, vector paths and document-format conversion
capabilities.implemented: Internal interpreter/device geometry exists; no public document-to-SVG/HTML exporter.
capabilities.remaining: Stable vector/text export API and baseline conversion probes; preserve PDF semantics and font licensing.

capabilities.feature: Viewer preferences, print settings, transitions and presentation
capabilities.implemented: Page boxes/rotation and low-level catalog entries are readable; browser page navigation exists.
capabilities.remaining: Typed viewer preferences and print presets; print rendering, transitions, duplex/copies/ranges and host integration.

capabilities.feature: Sound, movie, rich media and 3D interaction
capabilities.implemented: Static annotation appearance painting is independent of media playback.
capabilities.remaining: Runtime/API probes and explicit host contracts for media/3D; appearance display is not activation.

capabilities.implemented: Shared PDF syntax/content paths can open some profile-labelled documents.
capabilities.remaining: Feature-by-feature profile inventory, actual baseline API/build applicability, validation and authoring contracts.

capabilities.feature: Native/WASI transport, caches, cancellation and scheduling
capabilities.implemented: Bounded session protocol, native/WASI adapters, viewport generations, browser deadlines and queued-work cancellation.
capabilities.remaining: Within-request cancellation, persistent jobs, fair scheduling and broader device/transport evidence.

capabilities.feature: Recovery, limits, fuzzing, parity and performance evidence
capabilities.implemented: Bounded APIs, repair diagnostics, generated fixtures, fuzz targets and six-engine benchmark policy.
capabilities.remaining: Current cross-platform/corpus runtime comparison, complete feature denominator and release-qualified performance evidence.

annotation.appearance.rationale: Synthesis handles only selected subtypes; nonempty widgets, rotated widgets, relief/rounded borders and Square BE/RD still refuse. Existing appearance streams remain supported.

appearance.border-style.rationale: Generated form appearances reject unsupported border styles and rounded border radii.

appearance.default-appearance.rationale: Default-appearance parsing accepts a bounded operator subset; other valid appearance programs need interpretation or explicit fallback.

appearance.font-encoding.rationale: Editing requires reversible simple horizontal encodings; Type 0, vertical and unmappable characters remain outside the appearance writer.

appearance.text-matrix.rationale: Oblique/reflected matrices, nonpositive scales, negative leading and negative font sizes are outside supported editable layout.

appearance.update.rationale: Multiple/nested Tx scopes, crossed scopes, inline images and inseparable artwork can prevent safe appearance replacement.

appearance.widget-rotation.rationale: Nonzero widget rotation is not implemented in form appearance generation.

asn1.constructed-type.rationale: Generic DER accepts sequence/set and a controlled BER octet-string deviation; other universal constructed types are refused. Probe actual CMS/certificate uses before scheduling additional ASN.1 types.

asn1.universal-type.rationale: Universal primitives outside the implemented DER set are refused; this does not imply all ASN.1 types are required by supported PDF signature profiles.

ccitt.extension.rationale: The two-dimensional CCITT extension mode is explicitly refused; ordinary Group 3/4 paths exist.

colorspace.BlackPoint.rationale: Nonzero calibrated-space BlackPoint is not implemented; zero remains supported.

colorspace.ICCBased.rationale: ICC v2/v4 forward transforms exist. Other versions/forward types and lut8 XYZ refuse; inverse mBA is not a forward transform. ICC admission/fallback must be distinguished from destination-profile support.

colorspace.unknown.rationale: Unknown colour-space families refuse explicitly; the standard supported families must not be counted missing from this catch-all.

document.historical-encryption.rationale: An older revision with an Encrypt dictionary cannot be materialized.

document.historical-source.rationale: History beyond the current revision requires unrepaired, unencrypted input; current-document access is separate.

evidence.needle: historical access requires unrepaired unencrypted source

edit.button-appearance.rationale: Saving a button requires reusable normal appearance states; generating absent states is missing.

edit.direct-field.rationale: Direct/nested field or widget identities cannot always be rewritten unambiguously by the incremental form saver.

edit.encrypted.rationale: Modified encrypted saves need encryption-on-write; unchanged source-byte preservation is separate.

edit.password.rationale: Password field persistence is deliberately refused by the save contract; this is a policy boundary, not an instruction to persist secrets.

edit.repaired.rationale: Incremental modification requires strict source; a safe full rewrite for repaired input remains a separate missing operation.

edit.signed.rationale: Signed/indeterminate input requires explicit PreserveSignedBytes opt-in. The tag is not a blanket absence of signed-byte preservation or evidence of permission enforcement.

filter.CCITTFaxDecode.rationale: The generic stream codec returns an image-codec boundary; pagura-image performs this decoding. This tag alone is not an engine feature gap.

evidence.needle: image codecs are decoded by the image layer

filter.DCTDecode.rationale: The generic stream codec returns an image-codec boundary; pagura-image performs this decoding. This tag alone is not an engine feature gap.

evidence.needle: image codecs are decoded by the image layer

filter.JBIG2Decode.rationale: The generic stream codec returns an image-codec boundary; pagura-image performs this decoding. This tag alone is not an engine feature gap.

evidence.needle: image codecs are decoded by the image layer

filter.JPXDecode.rationale: Generic filter dispatch is implemented through pagura-image. Actual JPX refusals include Part 2/extensions, >16-bit samples/palettes, >30 coefficient planes, arithmetic bounds, later tile-part PPT bodies and incomplete/multiple/per-colour opacity associations.

evidence.needle: JPEG 2000 PPT headers preceding a later tile-part are not implemented
JPEG 2000 coefficient precision exceeds 30 bit planes
per-colour JP2 opacity is not implemented
JPEG 2000 PPT headers preceding a later tile-part are not implemented
JPEG 2000 reversible intermediate exceeds exact integer precision

filter.unknown.rationale: Unknown filter names are explicitly refused; this does not establish a missing standard filter.

font.cid-substitute-vertical.rationale: Vertical CID substitution is missing. Embedded vertical font handling is a different, implemented path.

font.cmap-program.rationale: CMap operators requiring PostScript execution exceed the declarative CMap reader.

font.format.rationale: Synthetic CFF, CharstringType other than 2, CFF2 FontDICT matrices and additional post formats remain unsupported; ordinary TrueType/CFF/CFF2 support exists.

font.non-embedded.rationale: Metrics-only outline requests and absent descriptors/providers can refuse; standard-14 and opt-in bundled CJK substitution exist. Unknown collection/encoding coverage remains a provider-dependent gap.

font.predefined-cmap.rationale: Predefined CMaps depend on installed provider data; bundled CJK maps exist, while unbundled names and unsupported predefined ToUnicode requests refuse.

font.type1-postscript.rationale: Computed assignments/procedures, unknown binary-reader aliases, computed matrices and nonhorizontal advances exceed the static Type 1 subset.

evidence.needle: nonstatic Type 1 procedure is not implemented

font.variations.rationale: Retained declaration/ALL entry has no live refusal caller. CFF2 default-location blends exist; this does not claim arbitrary variation-instance support.

form.field-type.rationale: Generic filling/variable-text appearance APIs reject field kinds they cannot handle, including signature fields; signature creation has its own package.

form.rich-text.rationale: Rich text filling and appearance generation are explicitly unavailable.

form.xfa.rationale: XFA-backed form fill/appearance generation is refused; saved static appearances are a separate display path.

function.calculator.rationale: The static calculator checker rejects data-dependent stack effects, unequal branch depths/types and mixed dynamic roll; valid programs outside this bounded subset need probes.

graphics.singular-stroke.rationale: A noninvertible stroke transform cannot be planned. Degenerate-input semantics need a focused oracle; do not count all strokes as missing.

image.JPX-colour.rationale: Additional enumerated JPX colour spaces remain unsupported; recognized device-family mappings exist.

image.JPX-sample-layout.rationale: Direct PDF Indexed index/opacity channels are integrated. Container-palette opacity/channel mapping and samples beyond 16 bits remain representation limits; incomplete association rejection is a separate defensive boundary.

evidence.needle: Indexed JPX container-palette opacity requires channel mapping

image.embedded-alpha.rationale: Retained declaration has no live refusal caller. SMaskInData 1/2 support exists; remaining layouts are tracked by JPX-sample-layout and decoder refusals.

image.inline-colour-length.rationale: The low-level inline-length helper cannot resolve a resource colour-space name by itself; callers can supply Length or resolved resources. Probe the end-to-end case before treating this API boundary as a render gap.

jbig2.halftone-region.rationale: Compatibility declaration has no live refusal caller; halftone regions. Do not infer a missing capability from this tag.

jbig2.huffman-table.rationale: Compatibility declaration has no live refusal caller; user Huffman tables. Do not infer a missing capability from this tag.

jbig2.pattern-dictionary.rationale: Compatibility declaration has no live refusal caller; pattern dictionaries. Do not infer a missing capability from this tag.

jbig2.refinement-region.rationale: Compatibility declaration has no live refusal caller; generic refinement. Do not infer a missing capability from this tag.

jbig2.symbol-context.rationale: Compatibility declaration has no live refusal caller; retained arithmetic symbol contexts. Do not infer a missing capability from this tag.

jbig2.symbol-refinement.rationale: Compatibility declaration has no live refusal caller; refinement/aggregate symbols. Do not infer a missing capability from this tag.

jbig2.text-layout.rationale: Compatibility declaration has no live refusal caller; reference corners/transposition. Do not infer a missing capability from this tag.

jbig2.text-refinement.rationale: Compatibility declaration has no live refusal caller; text refinement. Do not infer a missing capability from this tag.

jbig2.profile.rationale: Compatibility declaration has no live refusal caller; profile metadata. Do not infer a missing capability from this tag.

jbig2.unknown-length.rationale: Compatibility declaration has no live refusal caller; unspecified generic lengths. Do not infer a missing capability from this tag.

jbig2.page-combination.rationale: Compatibility declaration has no live refusal caller; fixed page-combination conflicts now produce syntax errors. Do not infer a missing capability from this tag.

jbig2.segment-type.rationale: Compatibility declaration has no live refusal caller; reserved segment types now produce syntax errors. Do not infer a missing capability from this tag.

jbig2.mmr-extension.rationale: Compatibility declaration has no live refusal caller; T.6 extensions forbidden by the embedded JBIG2 contract now produce syntax errors. Do not infer a missing capability from this tag.

jbig2.extended-template.rationale: Extended adaptive templates from the amendments are explicitly refused.

evidence.needle: extended JBIG2 adaptive templates are not implemented

jbig2.extension.rationale: Unknown necessary extensions refuse; unrecognized non-necessary extensions are skipped. A concrete baseline-supported extension is required before adding implementation work.

jbig2.symbol-dictionary.rationale: The public decoder routes Huffman flags to huffman_symbol::decode before the arithmetic-only reader. Its retained refusal is an internal dispatch guard, not a missing Huffman capability.

evidence.needle: JBIG2 Huffman symbol dictionaries are not implemented

jbig2.text-region.rationale: The public decoder routes Huffman flags to huffman_text::decode before the arithmetic-only reader. Its retained refusal is an internal dispatch guard, not a missing Huffman capability.

evidence.needle: JBIG2 Huffman text regions are not implemented

jpeg.arithmetic.rationale: Sequential/progressive arithmetic JPEG is implemented; the tag remains for arithmetic lossless/differential/hierarchical SOF processes (CB/CD/CE/CF).

jpeg.components.rationale: Sample output supports one, three or four planes; other JPEG component counts refuse.

jpeg.precision.rationale: Eight- and twelve-bit samples are supported; other precision/process combinations refuse, including malformed baseline precision. This is not an eight-bit-only decoder.

jpeg.process.rationale: Lossless/hierarchical JPEG and deferred DNL height are real refusals. The native-plane fast path also uses this tag when it falls back to the ordinary decoder.

evidence.needle: use the ordinary decoder to report the failure

optionalcontent.usage.rationale: The engine applies the initial View event. It validates Print/Export applications but does not select those events; categories requiring unavailable viewer context refuse. Event selection and richer context remain V05 work.

pattern.ExtGState.rationale: Pattern rendering parameters carried in ExtGState are not implemented.

pattern.image-mask.rationale: Pattern-coloured image stencils are not implemented in the paint planner.

pattern.tiling.rationale: Singular/collapsed tiling transforms are defensive boundaries; constant-spacing cells requiring excessive distortion are a remaining compatibility case.

predictor.dimensions.rationale: Colors above u8 and Columns above u32 exceed the bounded predictor representation; ordinary predictors are supported.

raster.singular-pen.rationale: A noninvertible stroke pen cannot enter the raster API; degenerate semantics need a targeted oracle, not a general stroke gap.

security.Adobe-PubSec.rationale: The Adobe public-key security handler is explicitly unsupported; Standard password security is separate.

security.CFM.rationale: Delegated None and unknown crypt-filter methods refuse; implemented Identity/RC4/AES methods must not be labelled missing.

security.V3.rationale: Unpublished encryption algorithm version 3 is deliberately refused; there is no defined interoperability target in this tag.

security.crypt-length.rationale: Non-identity crypt filters whose key length differs from the file key are not supported.

security.password-encoding.rationale: CLI conversion rejects Unicode not representable in legacy PDFDocEncoding; raw-byte library/host inputs and modern UTF-8 preparation have separate contracts.

security.revision.rationale: The Standard handler supports revisions 2 through 6; unknown revision numbers refuse rather than imply a missing known revision.

security.unknown.rationale: Unknown security handlers require a named baseline-supported extension and host contract; this catch-all is not evidence all security is missing.

security.version.rationale: Known encryption algorithm versions 1, 2, 4 and 5 are handled; other values refuse explicitly.

shading.transform.rationale: Singular shading transforms/matrices cannot be inverted; ordinary shading support is unaffected.

signature.algorithm.rationale: RSA v1.5/PSS and ECDSA P-256/384/521 with supported hashes exist. Other key/hash/curve/MGF identifiers refuse; G01 must identify any applicable baseline-supported algorithms.

stream.external.rationale: Stream dictionaries with F require a missing host-resolved external-stream contract.

text.structure-content.rationale: Tagged extraction cannot associate uncaptured external/form content streams with the current page capture.

text.structure-namespace.rationale: Namespace-specific RoleMapNS and nonstandard namespaces are outside current role resolution.

text.structure-replacement.rationale: Replacements crossing logical items, multiple pages or noncontiguous glyph associations are unsupported.

transparency.BM.rationale: Unknown blend-mode names refuse; this tag does not indicate missing standard blend modes.

transparency.group.rationale: Unknown group subtypes refuse; standard Transparency groups are implemented.

transparency.group-colorspace.rationale: Device families and ICC fallback are supported; calibrated/Lab-input and inverse destination ICC transforms remain missing.

transparency.transfer.rationale: Fractional correlated coverage and per-colourant/pattern transfer-region selection remain unsupported.

xobject.jpx-color.rationale: Embedded ICC forward profiles and eight-bit unsigned sYCC are integrated. Other/mixed sYCC precisions, Lab-input ICC and unsupported component counts remain explicit rendering gaps; device-family mappings already exist.

evidence.needle: embedded JPX Lab-input ICC range interpretation is not implemented

xobject.subtype.rationale: Form/Image paths exist; unknown or historical XObject subtypes refuse. Compare any valid baseline-supported PostScript XObject behavior separately from malformed subtype values.

pdfium.scope: Public headers and wrapper API inventory, including optional build flags; wrapper absence is not engine absence.

mupdf.scope: PDFDocument/Page and Python wrapper families; optional libraries, languages and providers need distinct runtime identities.

operations.forms.data-exchange: form event and data APIs to probe per binding

pdfjs.scope: Document proxy/loading APIs plus separate browser viewer runtime; Node raster adapter is insufficient for viewer operations.

operations.interaction.scripts-xfa: allXfaHtml / isPureXfa / getJSActions and viewer scripting

poppler.scope: GLib document API families; pdftoppm does not establish absence of non-render operations.

operations.profiles.validation: PDF subtype/profile labels; detection is not conformance validation

hayro.scope: Version 0.8.0 raster API and syntax/interpret reexports; prose limitations are candidates, not runtime exclusions.

quartz.scope: CGPDFDocument documentation and Swift drawing adapter: provider/file opening, version/pages/catalog/Info and password/permission queries. PDFKit is a separate framework and is not silently included in this CoreGraphics baseline.
